items.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you do any scales back then, Cherney, or any of these exercises?

ctx.x: Nothing that [ ] classical good pianist. Today I do Hannon once in a while, but I never bothered when I should have, when I was young, to help get some fingers more quickly.
Did you do any scales back then, Cherney, or any of these exercises?
